name: Grace Window
author: CoolJam
description: Reopen "closed" windows with SUPER + SHIFT + W. It remaps SUPER + W to hide the focused window to workspace 10 with a one-minute reopen grace period. Important note: run `~/.config/omarchy/plugins/jam.grace-window/install.sh` after adding this plugin for the custom keybindings and run `~/.config/omarchy/plugins/jam.grace-window/uninstall.sh` before removing it.
